# DRBE_Workload

**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
A specific TCC workload implementing the DRBE MVP chain: IQ replay → FFT → DBF → topology page switching → metric output. Represents the primary validated use case for TCC, demonstrating the end-to-end functionality and serving as a reference for other workloads.
